status: A mirror of app/src/calmframes/calmStyles.ts, which is the source of truth. Where the two disagree the code is right and this file is stale. eval/tests/test_design_page.py checks every value here against calmStyles.ts and against docs/design/README.md, and recomputes every contrast ratio.
keyMapping: Colour keys are the CALM_COLORS names in camelCase: BACKGROUND is background, SURFACE_FOCUSED is surfaceFocused, FOCUS_RING is focusRing, TEXT_DIM is textDim, and so on. Type keys are the CALM_TEXT names, spacing keys the CALM_SPACE names in camelCase (SAFE_X is safeX).
units: 1080p layout units on a 1920 by 1080 canvas. scale() in calmStyles.ts turns them into dp for the current screen height, rounded to the nearest pixel.

font.note: Licensed static OFL faces with unique matching internal family/file names; original artwork fonts remain unchanged.

contrastMeasurements.method: WCAG 2.2 relative luminance and contrast ratio, computed from the hex values above and truncated to two decimals the way roundRatio in app/src/calmframes/uiContrast.ts does, so a ratio is never rounded up past a floor.
